title: Biomechanical Analysis: Maximizing Vertical Reach on Mikasa V200W
excerpt: Detailed breakdown of the 3-step penultimate footwork approach and aerodynamic dimple surface mastery for spike accuracy.
content:
The official Mikasa V200W ball features aerodynamic double-dimple microfiber skin engineered to stabilize air turbulence.

Key biomechanical tips:
1. Penultimate Step: Lower body center of gravity on step two, driving heel-to-toe transition.
2. Full Arm Extension: Contact the ball at apex vertical elevation, wrapping wrist over the top.
3. Taraflex Landing: Dissipate ground reaction forces evenly across knee and hip flexors.

title: DVA Academy Season 2026: Youth & Junior Tryout Admissions Open
excerpt: Official tryout registrations now open for U14 (Kid Academy) and U21 (Junior Team). Full scholarship and official kit sponsorship available.
content:
DVA Volleyball Club is scouting talented athletes for our competitive development pipeline.
